zh_CN: 护士站里，弘子正向一名陌生护士交代工作。对方将几张交接资料整齐地收进文件夹，听见脚步声，抬头看向坂口。
en: At the nurses' station, Hiroko is briefing an unfamiliar nurse. The woman neatly puts several handover sheets into a folder, then looks up at Sakaguchi as she hears footsteps.

zh_CN: 「先生，正好。给您介绍一下。」
en: “Doctor, perfect timing. Let me introduce someone.”

zh_CN: 「这是新调来的氷上冴子，今后在内科工作。」
en: “This is Saeko Hikami. She's just transferred here and will be working in internal medicine.”

zh_CN: 「氷上冴子。请多关照。」
en: “Saeko Hikami. I look forward to working with you.”

zh_CN: 她稍稍欠身，声音平稳。比起紧张，更像是已经把报到时该说的话准备好了。
en: She bows slightly, her voice steady. Rather than nervous, she seems to have already prepared everything she needs to say on her first day.

zh_CN: 「已经开始交接了？」
en: “Have you started the handover already?”

zh_CN: 「是。病区和排班正在请杉村前辈带我熟悉。」
en: “Yes. Ms. Sugimura is showing me the wards and the duty schedule.”

zh_CN: 「手续都办好了。剩下的事情，可以一边工作一边教她。」
en: “The paperwork is all done. We can teach her the rest as she works.”

zh_CN: 坂口点点头，又看了冴子一眼。
en: Sakaguchi nods, then glances at Saeko again.

zh_CN: 「氷上……听说你来这里，还有别的目的？」
en: “Hikami... I heard you had another reason for coming here?”

zh_CN: 「人物简介是这么写的。」
en: “That's what my character profile says.”
“...What?”

zh_CN: 「没什么。您继续。」
en: “Nothing. Please go on.”

zh_CN: 她的表情没有变化。坂口看向弘子，弘子低头翻过一页排班表。
en: Her expression does not change. Sakaguchi looks at Hiroko, who lowers her eyes and turns a page of the duty roster.

zh_CN: 「总之，先熟悉工作吧。你的事情，以后再说。」
en: “Anyway, get used to the work first. We can talk about your situation later.”

zh_CN: 「请不要说以后。」
en: “Please don't say later.”

zh_CN: 这次回答得很快。
en: This time, her answer comes quickly.

zh_CN: 「怎么了？」
en: “What's wrong?”

zh_CN: 「上次也是这么等的。」
en: “That's how I waited last time, too.”

zh_CN: 「上次？」
en: “Last time?”

zh_CN: 「说我另有目的，背景很神秘，后面应该有戏份。」
en: “They said I had an ulterior motive, a mysterious background, and probably a story coming later.”

zh_CN: 「结果等到系列腰斩，伏笔没交代，我只能去打麻将。」
en: “Then the series got axed, the setup never paid off, and all I could do was go play mahjong.”

zh_CN: 「所以，这次能先把我的剧情排上吗？」
en: “So, could you put my story on the schedule first this time?”

zh_CN: 弘子抽出一张纸，递给她。
en: Hiroko pulls out a sheet of paper and hands it to her.

zh_CN: 「我先给你排了明天的早班。」
en: “I've put you on tomorrow's early shift first.”

zh_CN: 冴子接过排班表，低头看了一会儿，又确认了一遍上面的名字。
en: Saeko takes the roster and studies it for a while, then checks the name on it once more.

zh_CN: 「……至少这次是护士的工作了。」
en: “...At least I'm working as a nurse this time.”
